proof_summary: For the sequence defined by the candidate linear recurrence, the proof studies the Hankel-type error \(F_n=L_{n+1}^2-L_{n+2}L_n\), showing from \(F_{n+3}=4F_{n+1}+F_n\) and growth bounds that \(0<F_n\le L_n\). Hence \(L_{n+2}L_n<L_{n+1}^2\le (L_{n+2}+1)L_n\), so the ceiling-minus-one rule returns exactly \(L_{n+2}\); induction then identifies the nonlinear and linear sequences.
